subject: [PATCH] mm/mlock: use the IRQ-safe accessor for NR_MLOCK in __munlock_folio()

reviews.author: Hugh Dickins
reviews.summary:
Reviewer Hugh Dickins noted that the rare fallback case where PG_mlocked is cleared late can occur at interrupt time, and therefore the shortcut in __munlock_folio() should not be taken.

Reviewer Hugh Dickins noted that the patch does not address a separate issue related to offlining a CPU, which was reported by syzbot and resulted in a WARNING. He suggested adding Reported-by and Closes tags to acknowledge the report and indicate that it is fixed by this patch.
reviews.raw_body:
I'm hardly ashamed to admit that I've not tried to digest
that paragraph. You're writing about the rare fallback cases when
PG_mlocked is cleared late, and unevictable_pgs_cleared incremented to
notify us of that defect: yes, I accept that might happen at interrupt
time, and so we ought not to take the __shortcut in __munlock_folio()
which you fix  below.

---

Acked-by: Hugh Dickins <hughd@google.com>

But I do think you (or Andrew :-) should include

Reported-by: syzbot+cd2073ee6d958a8d0fcd@syzkaller.appspotmail.com
Closes: https://lore.kernel.org/linux-mm/6a931c5a.08e933ee.dbf97.0093.GAE@google.com/

That was indeed reporting a different way to get a WARNING from this,
when offlining a CPU: but it should be acknowledged for bringing you
here, and we should tell syzbot it's fixed by this.

I've been trying to work out whether you're going to come back in a
day or two, changing the __count_vm_events() too: and had raised in
that thread the question of why lru_add_drain()'s __count_vm_events
were not also reported by syzbot; but now I can see
 * vm counters are allowed to be racy. Use raw_cpu_ops to avoid the
 * local_irq_disable overhead.
and realize that they're not a problem; so this looks complete, we
shouldn't need local_lock()ing in mlock_drain_remote() after all.

Thanks,
Hugh

2026-09-01.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the Linux kernel's memory locking mechanism where NR_MLOCK, a counter of locked pages, could be overstated due to concurrent access from interrupt context and user space. The issue arises when a folio is munlocked while still pinned by a bio completion handler. To fix this, the patch uses an IRQ-safe accessor for NR_MLOCK in __munlock_folio(), specifically zone_stat_mod_folio(). This ensures that the counter update is atomic and accurate, preventing permanent overstatement of locked pages in /proc/meminfo.

reviews.author: Shakeel Butt (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged that the IRQ-safe accessor should be used in __munlock_folio() to prevent lost decrements of NR_MLOCK, but did not confirm if a fix is planned.
reviews.raw_body:
Thanks a lot Hugh for taking a look and Andrew has already added the syzbot
tags.
